title: 20 Minute Peanut Butter Udon
intro: I made the viral trendy peanut butter noodles and was shocked to discover that one portion of this recipe is pretty high - wait till the end to find out
method: Start by boiling 60 grams of noodles, i used udon
In a pan, cook all your veges whatever your heart desires - i used mushroom, capsicum and garlic
To make the sauce, add 1.5 - 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbspsoy sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp sesame seeds and 2 tbsp some water
Add in the noodles, veges and some more chilli oil, add more water if you want the sauce to be thinner
Serve it hot :) or cold its upto you <3
